caption: The drawing depicts a single rocking chair positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The chair has a light green upholstered seat and backrest with a small, repeated pattern featuring subtle yellow and orange floral designs. The frame of the chair, including the curved armrests and rockers, is rendered in a brown wood tone with visible grain. The armrests are ornate, featuring outward spirals, and the rockers extend smoothly at the bottom, allowing the chair to rock back and forth. The chair cushion and back are thick and plush, and the overall composition has a straightforward perspective, focusing attention entirely on the chair without any additional objects or background elements.
title: Rocking Chair
